correctness.rationale: The endomorphism-algebra normal form and determinant criterion are proved for every finite field and m>=2. Three explicit commutation minors exactly characterize the internal centralizers. Counting nonzero scalar pairs with fixed difference produces every stratum and centralizer order; orbit-stabilizer and Burnside yield the conjugacy-class and commuting-probability formulas. Direct program replay over seven (q,m) values, including F4 and three fully explicit matrix checks, corroborates the proof without serving as its infinite justification.

value.rationale: The entire conjugacy-class size spectrum for invertible centralizers of Jordan type (m,1) is a motivated finite-group invariant. For all finite fields and unbounded Jordan lengths, it exhibits a sharp characteristic-two disappearance and a length-independent commuting probability, and refines low-dimensional all-matrix branching. This is an infinite-family structural enumeration, not an unmotivated finite slice or mere scalar substitution.
